$schema: Machine-readable feature state tracker. Source of truth for status; per-feature MD docs are source of truth for design/runtime.

policy.definition_of_done: implementation complete + verify-done passed (CLI invoked against .brain, exit codes + TOON eyeballed, stderr diagnostics-only) + feature MD updated + brain skill --check green + brain coherent

features.name: Core AXI CLI
features.description: Zero-dep Node ESM `brain` CLI that reads/writes a target .brain harness (features, progress, runs, docs, search, context, setup, skill) and emits TOON on stdout.
features.evidence: manual: `node bin/brain.js` + every subcommand run against fixture .brain, exit codes + TOON output eyeballed; `brain skill --check` green; committed in c1b0880 (first iteration).

features.name: brain review — interactive plan review surface
features.description: Localhost HTTP server + browser chrome + injected artifact SDK. Agent writes an HTML plan, opens a review session, long-polls for annotations/feedback, applies edits, loops. Plans/reviews/screenshots/verifications persist into .brain. Includes execution mode (runs append, check, ship).
features.evidence: Execution dashboard verified PASS 2026-07-16: /watch/brain-review rendered all sections (pipeline, health 8/8, step accordion, checkpoints), runs-append appeared via SSE <5s no reload, unknown slug 404 with known slugs. Review flow regression: brain check 8/8 + skill --check green.

features.name: shot-review — screenshot carousel + annotation
features.description: In-page lightbox carousel for screenshots on both review surfaces (/watch dashboard + review chrome exec sidebar) replacing one-tab-per-image, plus pin-and-note annotation on screenshots that flows back to the agent for the next review round.
features.evidence: Verification PASS 2026-07-17 (features/shot-review/verifications/2026-07-17.md): Playwright walk of /watch/shot-review — lightbox opens in-page (pages() count asserted), arrow nav + filmstrip + counter, pin annotation POST 200 visible via shots notes (open, 39.9%,69.9%), Esc close, re-capture flips to superseded; E1 server-down shows inline error with note preserved. Zero jsErrors on golden path. skill --check + brain check green.

features.name: annotation-watch — post-ship feedback runner
features.description: Blocking `brain shots poll <feature>` runner the agent starts when a feature reaches shipped/PR state: waits for new reviewer pin-annotations from the /watch carousel and returns them TOON-formatted, closing the annotate→agent loop like review poll does for plans. Dashboard CTA reflects a live watcher.

features.name: harness-mode — AGENTS.md parity (verify runner + bookend playbooks + init)
features.description: Makes brain-axi a full 5-subsystem harness: `brain verify` runs a declared check registry (.brain/verify.json, stages bootstrap/baseline/verify) replacing bespoke init.sh + verify scripts; `start`/`done` bookend playbooks; `brain init` scaffolds a minimal .brain skeleton with optional AGENTS.md pointer. setup --commands generation deferred per plan harness-parity D0.
features.evidence: verify 2/2 pass recorded as run-note step 5 (features/harness-mode/runs/2026-07-23-progress.md); brain check 10 rows all-pass incl. verify.json registry row; skill --check exit 0; init scaffold round-trip verified in scratch (check/verify/context/progress all exit 0, re-init opError, AGENTS.md+CLAUDE.md symlink); non-negotiables sweep 0 hits on 2749-line diff

features.name: ai-work — AI-aware harness (evals, golden sets, prompt review)
features.description: Makes the harness inclusive of AI work: a standing `ai` playbook (prompt contract, golden sets, eval design, pipelines/guardrails, agent topology, human loop, anti-patterns) plus AI branches in plan/start/execute/done; then an evals subsystem (.brain/evals suites, brain evals verbs, opt-in evals verify stage with frozen-case regression gate), eval review UI, prompt registry, and agent topology state. Per plan ai-work-harness (2026-07-28, reviewed 2 rounds).
features.evidence: Blocked 2026-07-31 to free the one-in-progress slot for state-integrity (harness-hardening plan, 2026-07-31). ai-work itself is unblocked work — the evals subsystem it shipped is a dependency of state-integrity's Phase 2 eval suite. Resume by flipping back to in-progress once state-integrity ships.

features.name: planning-ux — product-grade planning (mockups, UX flows, product playbook)
features.description: Adds two standing playbooks — `product` (problem/evidence, user + JTBD, success metric, non-goals, scope tiers, prior art, recommendation-with-rationale) and `ux` (wireframe CSS kit, screen inventory, screen-state matrix, user-journey flow, variant decision cards) — plus conditional branches in plan/start/done, skill regeneration, rules doc, and skill-coverage eval cases. Phase 4 (gated): approved mockup persisted as verify evidence. Per plan product-planning-mockups (2026-07-30, approved round 1, all 6 decisions at recommended).
features.evidence: Verification PASS 2026-07-30 (features/planning-ux/verifications/2026-07-30.md): browser walk of the reconciled planning UI — wireframes render, annotate + decision round-trip, E1 offline mermaid fallback, E2 offline queue; 4 screenshots captured. PR #13 squash-merged to main 2026-07-30 (523c55c). verify 3/3 pass (skill-sync, harness, playbook-refs).

features.name: state-integrity — enforceable state, commit-bound evidence, gate telemetry
features.description: Make the state layer enforce its own invariants: strict feature-list schema in brain check (today the first check only asserts valid JSON), preflight-then-commit ship with atomic writes (today it writes at bin/brain.js:1025+:1033 then validates at :1037 without rollback), one verdict parser (today parseVerdict decides by emoji substring so `**Verdict**: PASS` reads as unknown while brainCheck passes it), commit-bound verification evidence reusing gitCommit(), shipped-requires-PASS behind --strict, init --state-only for template clones, brain metrics over a gates.jsonl written by brain verify, and a generated features/index.md. Prerequisite 1.0 gives the CLI its first automated verification (scripts/check-state-invariants.mjs + first CI) since the repo has zero tests by policy. Per plan harness-hardening (2026-07-31).
features.evidence: 2026-08-06 verification PASS (features/state-integrity/verifications/2026-08-06.md, receipt bound to e2df4da): brain check 16/16 + strict rows clean, brain verify 4/4, check-state-invariants.mjs 222 assertions, skill --check clean, metrics reporting 20 gate executions. Error paths proven to refuse: unknown status enum rejected field-precisely (exit 1), plain-text **Verdict**: PASS read as PASS, ship preflight refused with feature_list.json byte-identical, init --state-only resets a cloned template. Independent source audit confirmed all 8 defects present AND enforced from real gate paths.

features.name: task-coordination — a unit of work below the feature
features.description: Add tasks as first-class, gate-checked state under each feature so a coordinator can hand phases to sub-agents without holding the phase list in its own context. Per plan task-coordination (2026-08-06, reviewed round 1, tier: complete = phases 1-4): features/<slug>/tasks.json with a schema + optional depends_on (cycle-detected) in lib/state.js, compare-and-swap claiming so parallel workers cannot lose a write, evidence required to close a task and bound to a commit receipt under the same ancestor-of-HEAD rule as a verification verdict, two brain check rows (task schema; no shipped feature with an open task), gated autoship on the last task (refuses without a PASS verification; --no-autoship opts out), brain brief composing the task + acceptance + approved decision prompts from reviews.jsonl + the rules owning the touched files, runs append --task --author, and the execute playbook rewritten as a coordinator/worker loop. Non-goals: brain never spawns an agent; one_in_progress_at_a_time stays in force at the feature level; phases are never scraped out of plan HTML.
features.evidence: 2026-08-06 verification PASS (features/task-coordination/verifications/2026-08-06.md, receipt bound to 2017620): 409 assertions (from 222), check 18/18, check --strict 21/21, verify 4/4, skill --check clean. Dogfooded on itself — phases 2/3/4 seeded as real tasks and claimed+closed by independent worker agents through the CLI. Error paths proven: open task blocks ship with feature_list.json byte-identical, depends_on cycle named at both ends, no close without evidence (exit 2), two concurrent claims through the real CLI yield exactly one winner 3/3, gated autoship refused on the unverified feature leaving it in-progress. Seven defects found and closed during the build, three by adversarial review of work that had already reported success.
